source_freeze.changes: Only manifest/payload loader and required public includes/helpers/weight-pool owners. Preserve320 device Buffer allocations, dtype/description/count/source ranges, original phase/math and original constructor/main startup/TTFT timing. No mapped checkpoint or full-size pinned bank. source_freeze.public_seam: WriteLease has no direct Buffer adopt. LeasePool::adopt takes each original allocation; each pool must remain alive/open until Graph reads retire because its destructor closes new native admission. Model retains320 pool handles (no extra device allocation) before its weight map; phases/state/weights destroy before those handles. This adds pool/control metadata during loading, whereas the original adopted ready weights during cold graph construction.
source_freeze.failure_contract: As in the existing public sample, the pipeline scope guard drains accepted work on exception before runtime teardown. First-time compilation and runtime behavior remain unverified. Do not declare gain or exact vectors from source review.

Separate four-process C/B/B/C follow-up: TTFT2.10647to1.42928s (-32.15%); full decode+0.71%,warm-0.435%,prefill-0.40%. The small full-decode loss did not reproduce with the same direction.
